title: GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens
author: Allison
description: You can now use expiring, automatically refreshing OAuth credentials in GitHub CLI as part of a public preview. When you opt in, gh stores an expiring access token alongside a… The post GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: You can now use expiring, automatically refreshing OAuth credentials in GitHub CLI as part of a public preview. When you opt in, gh stores an expiring access token alongside a rotating refresh token and automatically refreshes the token whenever it is needed.
takeaways: Using expiring tokens with git If you authenticate to git over HTTPS and want to use expiring tokens, we strongly recommend configuring gh as your git credential helper by running gh auth setup-git .
Who can use it Expiring tokens are available on github.com and ghe.com today.
For more on authenticating with GitHub CLI, including expiring tokens, see Authenticating with GitHub CLI .
